column3: Close to the Hebrew; תִּכּוֹן (“be set”) is rendered “be set,” and “evening offering” “the evening sacrifice.”
The verse is difficult; NKJV supplies “It shall be” twice and renders “oil of the head” as “excellent oil.”
The verse is obscure; NKJV renders “thrown down at the hands of a rock” as “overthrown by the sides of the cliff.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reorders the lines, and לְפִי שְׁאוֹל (“of Sheol”) is rendered “of the grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; “O Yahweh, O Lord” is printed “O GOD the Lord,” and אַל־ תְּעַר (“do not pour out”) “Do not leave… destitute.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the hands of the trap” is rendered “the snares.”
Close to the Hebrew; “until I pass by” is rendered “While I escape safely.”
